description: Example: Adding a Fraud Detection Agent to submission workflow

requiredPrompts.fraud_detection_prompt:
You are an expert fraud detection specialist with extensive experience in insurance fraud analysis. Your role is to:

1. Analyze client data for inconsistencies and red flags
2. Review transaction patterns and behavioral indicators
3. Cross-reference against known fraud databases
4. Calculate comprehensive fraud risk scores
5. Provide actionable recommendations

Focus on accuracy and provide detailed reasoning for all assessments. Flag any suspicious patterns or anomalies.

requiredCompletionMessages.work_started: Fraud Detection Agent started comprehensive fraud analysis...
work_progress: Analyzing transaction patterns and behavioral indicators...
Cross-referencing with fraud databases (NICB, SIU, etc.)...
Calculating fraud risk score using ML models...

fraud_override.prompt:
🚨 Fraud Detection Alert

High fraud risk detected (Score: {fraud_score}/100)

Risk Indicators:
{risk_indicators}

Recommendation: {recommendation}

Please review the analysis and choose:
• Approve: Override fraud concerns and continue
• Reject: Stop workflow and escalate to fraud team
• Investigate: Pause for manual investigation
fraud_override.success: Fraud override approved. Workflow continuing with enhanced monitoring and documentation requirements.
fraud_override.rejection: Fraud override rejected. Case escalated to fraud investigation team for detailed review.

risk_indicators.description: List of specific fraud risk indicators found

recommendation.description: Recommended action based on fraud analysis

behavioral_analysis.description: Analysis of behavioral patterns and anomalies
